svg.title: Europlug CEE 7/16 plug (male), mating face
svg.desc: Schematic view of the pins. Flat body with side faces at 45°; two round pins on a horizontal line, line or neutral on either side (unpolarised). Filled circles are pins (male contacts). Proportions follow a 35.3 × 13.7 mm body, 4 mm pins and 18 mm between pin centres (17–18 mm at the tip, 18–19 mm at the base).
